automation_name: AI Dev Wiki Topic News Collector

cutoff_window.policy: Include only public web sources published or visibly updated within the last 2 days relative to the run time. Exclude missing, ambiguous, future-dated, stale, secondary-only, broad-upstream-only, and lower-boundary date-only candidates.

qualifying_updates.title: AppHandoff updates coding-agent handoff guidance around source-linked context packets
qualifying_updates.summary: AppHandoff describes AI coding handoffs as compact packets containing objective, constraints, current facts with sources, evidence, unknowns, and a next action. It warns that handoff packets are an entry point, not a substitute for checking current code and work records, and recommends refreshing mutable facts before dependent action.
qualifying_updates.why_it_matters: Local practice implication: context handoffs should preserve source, revision, and uncertainty metadata so agents resume from inspectable current facts rather than long transcripts or stale summaries.
qualifying_updates.routing_note: Do not duplicate broad context-engineering background; retain the downstream handoff packet, source-refresh, and uncertainty-recording practice.

qualifying_updates.title: Agent Harness Fundamentals frames autonomy around evidence, hooks, subagents, and human gates
qualifying_updates.summary: Luca Berton describes an agent-harness workflow where a coding agent implements a small change, a PostToolUse hook runs deterministic tests after edits, a read-only subagent reviews whether requested behavior and tests are preserved, permission rules constrain direct actions, and a human makes the final accept-or-reject decision.
qualifying_updates.why_it_matters: Local practice implication: reliable agent workflows should distinguish guidance from enforcement, collect hook/test/review evidence, keep reviewers independent from implementers, and leave final merge/deploy authority with humans.
qualifying_updates.routing_note: Upstream owns product and person background; local coverage should keep the harness, evidence, permission, and review-gate pattern.

qualifying_updates.title: Lamplit Labs maps coding agents into SDLC handoff points
qualifying_updates.summary: Lamplit Labs proposes four AI SDLC handoff points: a task contract in the issue tracker, a sandboxed run in a throwaway clone or worktree with scoped tokens and budgets, deterministic gates that the agent cannot edit, and human review over the diff, gate results, and run log.
qualifying_updates.why_it_matters: Local practice implication: assigned agent work should be treated as a pipeline participant with explicit scope, non-goals, stop conditions, immutable gates, logs, and human approval rather than as an editor autocomplete extension.
qualifying_updates.routing_note: Do not create product or platform coverage; retain downstream workflow contract, sandbox, gate, and operating-model implications.

qualifying_updates.title: Arelion case study shows AI-built code can pass functional checks while retaining security failures
qualifying_updates.summary: Arelion reports a read-only audit of an AI-built platform before production traffic that found 49 issues, nine high severity, across application code, cloud IAM, CI pipelines, infrastructure, and git history. The case study says passing deploys and functional tests did not catch leaked public-prefixed secrets, weak admin authorization, live credentials in history, or excessive cloud ownership.
qualifying_updates.why_it_matters: Local practice implication: AI-assisted delivery gates need source, IAM, CI, container, history, and attacker-perspective review, because functional acceptance checks alone do not validate security properties that were not in the prompt.
qualifying_updates.routing_note: Security-specific platform facts can route to the security wiki if needed; local ai-dev-wiki coverage should retain the AI-assisted development risk and verification practice.

qualifying_updates.title: Munder Difflin daily roundup records agent-tool signals with checked sources and dated releases
qualifying_updates.summary: Munder Difflin's October 11 roundup records checked source links for coding-agent launches, skills, MCP servers, plugin changes, multi-agent tool moves, and public arguments. It reports its inclusion rule: each listed name needs an opened link and a visible signal such as points, stars, or a dated release, while social-only claims are left out.
qualifying_updates.why_it_matters: Local practice implication: collector and watcher workflows can use this as a model for source-visible recency, explicit evidence signals, and exclusion of unverified social claims, while routing broad product and tool facts upstream.
qualifying_updates.routing_note: The individual products and launches are upstream-owned. Local use is limited to source-collection practice and evidence-threshold implications.

qualifying_updates.title: RuleSkill exposes workflow-based agent-skill discovery with daily update signals
qualifying_updates.visible_date: Updated daily; page showed October 11, 2026 entries
qualifying_updates.summary: RuleSkill presents agent skills by developer workflow, including debugging, code review, testing, documentation, playbooks, and security audit categories, and shows per-skill update dates such as October 11, 2026. The catalog emphasizes GitHub-verified and open-source skills rather than only raw recency.
qualifying_updates.why_it_matters: Local practice implication: durable agent instructions should be selected by job-to-be-done, provenance, verification status, and update recency rather than copied wholesale into an always-loaded prompt.
qualifying_updates.routing_note: Catalog and skill-project background route upstream; local coverage should retain workflow-based skill selection, provenance, and update-recency practice.

follow_up_notes: Ingest should consider downstream leaves for context handoff packets, agent SDLC handoff contracts, evidence-producing harnesses, non-writable deterministic gates, and AI-built-code security review scope.
Do not ingest broad product, model, MCP server, catalog, funding, or company facts into local pages; route them upstream or keep only local practice implications.
Several October 10 date-only sources were excluded because the runtime cutoff was 2026-10-10T00:31:18Z and exact publication times were not visible.
collector_boundary_notes: No private, proprietary, sensitive, PII, or company-internal local content was sent to external services.
Broad ecosystem entities were marked upstream-owned and reduced to local practice implications.
